reading_note: The teaching describes the inward gathering — the upward recollection — of all things from the lowest natural degree back into their celestial origin. Each lower form is drawn into its next interior, fire into fire, wind into wind, until the natural goods reach the Tamr (a state of receptivity), then the Answer (response), then the Call (the awakening summons), then the chosen Noeric Mind (rational reception of truth), then the Pillar of Glory (the column of accumulated truth ascending), then the First Man (the original divine truth sent forth), then the Ambassador (the awakening influx), and finally into the Aeons of the Greatness — the celestial heavens. The arc traces the whole movement of regeneration: every good and truth in ultimates is drawn back into its inmost source and rests forever in the celestial state.
